transforms: Mask white outer corners with a 36px rounded rectangle at source resolution.
Derive unchanged 24x34/32x44 color masters from the original source with Lanczos; no recoloring, invented lettering, or reconstructed artwork.
Expand those masters with nearest-neighbor sampling to 36x51/48x66 at 480x360, matching the 1.5x texel scale of Pokemon portraits.
Keep each target resolution's original rounded alpha mask.
Native variants quantize RGB to five bits and alpha to one bit.
Web art expands the same 32x44 color master to the existing 256x357 file dimensions.
